  "memo":"R03 holds: the Nigerian IP differs from the US card issuing country and AVS failed. Card is the only adverse family; all other rule conditions fail. Travel with an address-verification mismatch is the strongest benign explanation. No installments are due, so nonpayment provides no evidence. Recommend needs_check under §6.6(b), implemented as a hold for id_check. No check has run and the order is unshipped.
